constraints.name: inventory_movements_org_item_fk
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (organization_id, item_id) REFERENCES inventory_items(organization_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT NOT VALID

constraints.name: inventory_movements_v2_contract_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (contract_version < 2 OR organization_id IS NOT NULL AND (movement_kind = ANY (ARRAY['OPENING_BALANCE'::text, 'PURCHASE'::text, 'SALE'::text, 'SALES_RETURN'::text, 'PURCHASE_RETURN'::text, 'MANUAL_ADJUSTMENT'::text, 'SHIPMENT_RECEIPT'::text, 'REVERSAL'::text, 'MIGRATION_RECONCILIATION'::text])) AND signed_base_quantity IS NOT NULL AND signed_base_quantity <> 0 AND NULLIF(btrim(source_type), ''::text) IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(btrim(source_id), ''::text) IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(btrim(command_id), ''::text) IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(btrim(idempotency_key), ''::text) IS NOT NULL AND occurred_at IS NOT NULL AND recorded_at IS NOT NULL AND created_by IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(btrim(device_id), ''::text) IS NOT NULL AND (movement_kind = 'REVERSAL'::text AND reverses_movement_id IS NOT NULL OR movement_kind <> 'REVERSAL'::text AND reverses_movement_id IS NULL) AND ((movement_kind <> ALL (ARRAY['PURCHASE'::text, 'SALES_RETURN'::text, 'SHIPMENT_RECEIPT'::text])) OR signed_base_quantity > 0) AND ((movement_kind <> ALL (ARRAY['SALE'::text, 'PURCHASE_RETURN'::text])) OR signed_base_quantity < 0)) NOT VALID
